propositions: The tickets branch is 1.04 GiB with 92% consisting of the reconciler's .bridge_state cache; the reconciler must keep this cache committed because it runs on ephemeral GitHub runners and durable state must live in git.

Per-version marginal git pack cost is 12.79 KB today; deleting the baseline_advanced_at timestamp alone reduces this to 1.74 KB (7.4x improvement), and moving last_get_pass rotation bookkeeping halves the version count (12.8x total reduction).

A one-time history rewrite using git fast-export/filter/fast-import reduces the existing branch from 1.17 GB to 98.8 MB (8.4%) while preserving all 49,888 commits and 2,661 merges; HEAD tree remains byte-identical after dynamic re-add of current files.

Three committed-format changes—deleting baseline_advanced_at, moving last_get_pass to get_rotation.json, and narrowing prev_snapshot.json to key-set—are reversible and use mixed-version read seams with no fixed elapsed-time gates, gated instead by descendant workflow execution and epoch mismatch refusal proof.

Rollout gates require operator attestation of descendant workflow execution, explicit host runtime refresh, live review-bot and host epoch-refusal probes, a verified off-repo backup bundle, and a quiesced publication window with zero active sessions and stopped rebar-mcp servers.

Post-publish rollback is an explicit quiesced window using direct ref replacement with --force-with-lease, off-repo bundle verification, and mandatory writer re-clone to enforce fail-closed epoch mismatch behavior without application-level union overrides.
